purpose: Teach: 證/噺/英和/云わ/ノベル/広東/にたいする/事物

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字「證」、つまり證書の鑑定を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: So the police will be getting that old-form certificate authenticated by experts, then?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Seeking confirmation with genuine curiosity. Respectful pace. Soft upward lift at the end—genuinely asking, not assuming.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の供述、つまり噺を、警察、検証されますね
lines.en: Right. We'll need to verify the suspect's account—the story they gave us—against the evidence.
lines.style: Straightforward, professional. Even-keeled delivery. Slight weight on the word 'verify' — this matters. Not defensive, just clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、押収品の英和辞典の書込みを、警察、分析されますね
lines.en: And the annotations in that English-Japanese dictionary from the seized items—the police will analyze those too?
lines.style: Steady, methodical tone. Each phrase placed with care. Quiet certainty underneath. Slight pause before the question mark, as if thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の云わくつき、つまり「言わくつき」の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: We're looking into the suspect's history—any prior incidents, any connections we need to flag.
lines.style: Clinical, matter-of-fact. No apology in the tone. Professional distance maintained. Brief, solid sentence weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人が読んでいたノベル、つまり小説を、警察、押収されますね
lines.en: So the novel the suspect was reading—that will be seized as evidence too?
lines.style: Quiet follow-up. Almost thinking out loud. Gentle curiosity, not pressing. Slight uncertainty in the inflection—inviting correction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、広東省での密輸事案も国際捜査で対応されますね
lines.en: Yes. The smuggling incident in Guangdong is being handled through international investigation channels.
lines.style: Assured, matter-of-fact. Scope has widened—delivered with calm confidence. No hesitation. Factual precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者にたいする救済措置を、警察、迅速におこなわれますね
lines.en: And the victim will receive proper support and compensation as quickly as possible?
lines.style: Gentle but direct. Concern present but controlled. Hopeful inflection on the question. This is what matters most to Ren right now.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の事物、つまり遺留品を、警察、丁寧に保管されますね
lines.en: Evidence from the scene will be handled with care and stored properly.
lines.style: Firm, reassuring. Weight on 'carefully' and 'properly'—this is non-negotiable. Warm but official. The tone of someone who takes this responsibility seriously.
